intro: The voice engine reads every live title and meta against the myCHEF writing system. Household pages talk to a family that does not want to become HR. Event pages talk to a host whose night cannot fail. A variant that fails this gate never reaches the snippet queue.

household.who: Affluent international residents and business families in Dubai villas and apartments.
household.fear: Letting the wrong person into the house, or becoming HR for a cook.
household.next: Understand the product versus employing someone, then ask for a match.
household.tone: Calm, specific, slightly conversational. Name the mechanism.

event_host.who: A host whose night cannot fail in front of guests — villa, yacht, office or wedding.
event_host.fear: The food, the staff or the timing collapsing in public.
event_host.next: See what the team does on the night, what is included, then send the date.
event_host.tone: Direct about the night. No household-chef copy pasted onto an event page.

planner.who: Someone comparing options before they pick a commercial page.
planner.fear: A guide that is secretly a sales page, or advice that does not match Dubai.
planner.next: Learn the decision, then follow the link to the owner page.
planner.tone: Useful first. Link to the owner. Do not steal a commercial primary.
